question: A sum of money lent at simple interest amounts to Rs. 7,920 in 2 years and to Rs. 11,220 after 5 more years. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

A₁ = 7920, T₁ = 2 years

A₂ = 11220, T₂= 7 years

**Formula used:**

**1**. SI = (PRT)/(100)

**2**. Amount = P + SI

**Concept Used:**

Amount = P + (PRT)/(100) = P(1 + (RT)/(100))

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

7920 = P{(1+ (2R)/(100))} -----(1)

11220 = P{(1+ (7R)/(100))} -----(2)

Equation(1) ÷ Equation(2)

⇒ 792 + {(7 ×792 × R)/(100)} = 1122 + {(2 × 1122 × R)/(100)} 

⇒ {(R)/(100)} (5544 - 2244) = 330

⇒ R = {(33000)/(3300)} 

⇒ R = 10%

SI of 5 years = Rs 3300

⇒ SI of 1 year = Rs 660

⇒ SI of 2 years = Rs 1320

P = A - SI

⇒ P = 7920 - 1320 = Rs 6600

SI = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ R = 1320 times 100over 6600 times 2 = 10%

**∴ The rate of interest per annum is 10%.**
